name: Blender
summary: Build and change 3D scenes in Blender while you watch.
description: Lets her build and change 3D scenes in Blender while you watch: add objects, set materials, move the camera. Blender and its add-on must be running.
about: Blender is the free 3D program. This tool server talks to a small add-on inside Blender, so she can look at your scene and change it step by step.

Install the add-on from the project's page (Edit → Preferences → Add-ons → Install from disk), switch it on, and press Connect in Blender's side panel. The server runs with uv (uvx), version 2.2.6 of mcp-for-blender.

mcp.name: blender
reaches: Blender on this computer (its add-on's local port)
guide: In Blender, install and switch on the add-on, then press Connect.
Add this tool server, then press Test.
